<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head><style>
@font-face {
  font-family: "Optimistic";
  font-style: normal;
  font-weight: 400 600;
  font-display: swap;
  src: url("/fonts/OptimisticAI_VF_Optimized.woff2") format("woff2");
}
@font-face {
  font-family: "Optimistic Mono";
  font-style: normal;
  font-weight: 400;
  font-display: swap;
  src: url("/fonts/OptimisticMono_W_TextRegular.woff2") format("woff2");
}
:where(html) {
  font-family: "Optimistic", system-ui, sans-serif;
}
:where(code, pre, kbd, samp) {
  font-family: "Optimistic Mono", ui-monospace, monospace;
}

/* ===== SILOH LOANS — 3D depth enhancements ===== */
* { -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent; }

h1, h2, h3 {
  text-shadow: 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.18), 0 2px 3px rgba(0,0,0,.3), 0 8px 14px rgba(0,0,0,.35);
}

@keyframes silohFloat3d {
  0%, 100% { transform: perspective(700px) rotateX(4deg) rotateY(0deg) translateY(0); }
  50% { transform: perspective(700px) rotateX(4deg) rotateY(1.5deg) translateY(-5px); }
}

.payment-card, .trust-card, .complaint-box {
  transform: perspective(900px) rotateX(0deg);
  transition: transform .2s ease, box-shadow .2s ease;
  box-shadow:
    0 16px 32px rgba(0,0,0,.28),
    0 2px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.55) inset,
    0 -8px 16px rgba(0,0,0,.06) inset;
}
.payment-card:active, .trust-card:active, .complaint-box:active {
  transform: perspective(900px) rotateX(3deg) scale(.985);
  box-shadow:
    0 6px 14px rgba(0,0,0,.24),
    0 2px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.4) inset;
}

@keyframes flagWave3d {
  0%   { transform: perspective(700px) rotate3d(0.1,1,0, 0deg) skewY(0deg) scaleY(1); }
  12%  { transform: perspective(700px) rotate3d(0.1,1,0.15, 7deg) skewY(1.2deg) scaleY(1.01); }
  25%  { transform: perspective(700px) rotate3d(0.1,1,0.3, -5deg) skewY(-1deg) scaleY(.99); }
  37%  { transform: perspective(700px) rotate3d(0.1,1,0.45, 9deg) skewY(1.5deg) scaleY(1.01); }
  50%  { transform: perspective(700px) rotate3d(0.1,1,0.2, -7deg) skewY(-1.2deg) scaleY(1); }
  62%  { transform: perspective(700px) rotate3d(0.1,1,0.4, 6deg) skewY(1deg) scaleY(1.01); }
  75%  { transform: perspective(700px) rotate3d(0.1,1,0.1, -8deg) skewY(-1.4deg) scaleY(.99); }
  87%  { transform: perspective(700px) rotate3d(0.1,1,0.3, 5deg) skewY(1deg) scaleY(1); }
  100% { transform: perspective(700px) rotate3d(0.1,1,0, 0deg) skewY(0deg) scaleY(1); }
}
.mpesa-box, .airtel-box {
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
  transform-origin: left center;
  transition: transform .18s ease, box-shadow .18s ease;
  box-shadow:
    0 14px 26px rgba(0,0,0,.4),
    inset 0 2px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.28),
    inset 0 -8px 14px rgba(0,0,0,.4);
}
.mpesa-box::after, .airtel-box::after {
  content: "";
  position: absolute; inset: 0;
  background: linear-gradient(120deg, rgba(255,255,255,.22) 0%, rgba(255,255,255,0) 38%);
  pointer-events: none;
}
.mpesa-box:active, .airtel-box:active {
  animation-play-state: paused;
  transform: perspective(700px) rotateX(0deg) scale(.97);
}
.mpesa-box h2, .airtel-box h2 {
  text-shadow: 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.35), 0 4px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.45);
}

button {
  transition: transform .1s ease, box-shadow .1s ease;
}
button:active {
  transform: translateY(3px) scale(.98) !important;
  box-shadow: 0 3px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.35) !important;
}

.pill, .airtel-tag {
  box-shadow: 0 3px 7px rgba(0,0,0,.25), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.45);
}

.amount-btn {
  transform: perspective(400px) translateZ(0);
  box-shadow: 0 7px 14px rgba(0,0,0,.25), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.3);
  transition: transform .1s ease, box-shadow .1s ease;
}
.amount-btn:active {
  transform: translateY(3px) scale(.96);
  box-shadow: 0 2px 6px rgba(0,0,0,.3);
}

.loan-selector > div {
  transition: transform .15s ease, box-shadow .15s ease;
}
.loan-selector > div:active {
  transform: scale(.97);
}

header { perspective: 1400px; }
.logo-cube-scene {
  width: 170px; height: 170px;
  margin: 0 auto;
  perspective: 1000px;
}
.logo-cube {
  position: relative;
  width: 100%; height: 100%;
  transform-style: preserve-3d;
  will-change: transform;
  animation: cubeSpin3d 11s linear infinite;
}
@keyframes cubeSpin3d {
  0%   { transform: rotateX(0deg) rotateY(0deg); }
  100% { transform: rotateX(360deg) rotateY(360deg); }
}
.cube-face {
  position: absolute;
  width: 170px; height: 170px;
  border-radius: 16px;
  border: 2px solid rgba(255,255,255,.28);
  box-shadow: inset 0 0 30px rgba(0,0,0,.3);
  background-size: 68%;
  background-repeat: no-repeat;
  background-position: center;
}
.cube-front  { transform: translateZ(85px); }
.cube-back   { transform: rotateY(180deg) translateZ(85px); }
.cube-right  { transform: rotateY(90deg) translateZ(85px); }
.cube-left   { transform: rotateY(-90deg) translateZ(85px); }
.cube-top    { transform: rotateX(90deg) translateZ(85px); }
.cube-bottom { transform: rotateX(-90deg) translateZ(85px); }
.cube-color {
  animation: cubeColorCycle 7s linear infinite;
}
@keyframes cubeColorCycle {
  0%    { background-color:#e11d48; }
  14.28%{ background-color:#7c3aed; }
  28.57%{ background-color:#16a34a; }
  42.85%{ background-color:#2563eb; }
  57.14%{ background-color:#6b3f1d; }
  71.42%{ background-color:#111111; }
  85.71%{ background-color:#eab308; }
  100%  { background-color:#e11d48; }
}
</style>

<style id="siloh-app-redesign">
/* SILOH LOANS — app-style visual redesign.
   Functionality/React handlers are intentionally left untouched. */
html, body {
  margin: 0 !important;
  background: #f4f7fb !important;
  min-height: 100% !important;
}
body {
  overflow-x: hidden !important;
  -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
}
#root > div {
  min-height: 100vh !important;
  background: #f4f7fb !important;
  color: #152238 !important;
}
#root > div > header {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg,#071b3a 0%,#0c2d5d 58%,#123f78 100%) !important;
  padding: 18px 16px 16px !important;
  border-radius: 0 0 28px 28px !important;
  box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(8,35,76,.20) !important;
}
.logo-cube-scene {
  width: 86px !important;
  height: 86px !important;
  perspective: none !important;
  filter: drop-shadow(0 8px 14px rgba(0,0,0,.30)) !important;
}
.logo-cube {
  animation: none !important;
  transform: none !important;
}
.cube-face {
  width: 86px !important;
  height: 86px !important;
  border-radius: 22px !important;
  border: 2px solid rgba(255,255,255,.45) !important;
  box-shadow: inset 0 0 20px rgba(0,0,0,.20) !important;
}
.cube-front  { transform: translateZ(43px) !important; }
.cube-back   { transform: rotateY(180deg) translateZ(43px) !important; }
.cube-right  { transform: rotateY(90deg) translateZ(43px) !important; }
.cube-left   { transform: rotateY(-90deg) translateZ(43px) !important; }
.cube-top    { transform: rotateX(90deg) translateZ(43px) !important; }
.cube-bottom { transform: rotateX(-90deg) translateZ(43px) !important; }
.cube-color { animation: none !important; background-color: #0d47a1 !important; }

#root > div > header > div:nth-child(2) {
  color: #dbeafe !important;
  letter-spacing: 2px !important;
}
#root > div > header button {
  background: rgba(255,255,255,.12) !important;
  border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.25) !important;
  color: #fff !important;
  border-radius: 14px !important;
  padding: 10px 16px !important;
}

#root > div > main {
  display: block !important;
  max-width: 520px !important;
  margin: -8px auto 0 !important;
  padding: 14px 12px 34px !important;
}
#root > div > main > form {
  width: 100% !important;
  box-sizing: border-box !important;
  background: #fff !important;
  border: 0 !important;
  border-radius: 24px !important;
  padding: 20px 16px !important;
  box-shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(25,52,90,.12) !important;
}
#root > div > main > form h2 {
  font-family: inherit !important;
  font-size: 25px !important;
  color: #10213c !important;
  text-shadow: none !important;
}
#root > div > main > form p {
  color: #70809a !important;
}

.field-input {
  box-sizing: border-box !important;
  width: 100% !important;
  height: 52px !important;
  background: #f7f9fc !important;
  border: 1.5px solid #dce3ee !important;
  border-radius: 15px !important;
  color: #17233a !important;
  font-size: 16px !important;
  outline: none !important;
  box-shadow: none !important;
}
.field-input:focus {
  border-color: #2563eb !important;
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px rgba(37,99,235,.10) !important;
}
#fullName.field-input,
#idNumber.field-input,
#phoneNumber.field-input,
#mpesaNumber.field-input {
  border: 1.5px solid #dce3ee !important;
}
#root > div > main > form label {
  color: #34445d !important;
}

.loan-selector {
  background: #f5f8ff !important;
  border: 0 !important;
  border-radius: 20px !important;
  padding: 14px !important;
}
.amount-box {
  display: flex !important;
  align-items: center !important;
  gap: 10px !important;
}
.amount-btn {
  width: 48px !important;
  height: 48px !important;
  flex: 0 0 48px !important;
  border: 0 !important;
  border-radius: 15px !important;
  background: #0b3d91 !important;
  color: #fff !important;
  font-size: 25px !important;
}
#loanAmount {
  flex: 1 !important;
  min-width: 0 !important;
  height: 48px !important;
  border: 0 !important;
  border-radius: 15px !important;
  background: #fff !important;
  color: #10213c !important;
  font-size: 22px !important;
  font-weight: 800 !important;
  text-align: center !important;
}
.loan-selector input[type="range"] {
  accent-color: #1769e0 !important;
  margin-top: 12px !important;
}

#root > div > main > form > div:nth-last-child(2) {
  background: linear-gradient(145deg,#071b3a,#123f78) !important;
  border: 0 !important;
  border-radius: 20px !important;
  box-shadow: 0 10px 22px rgba(7,27,58,.20) !important;
}
.pill {
  background: rgba(255,255,255,.12) !important;
  border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.20) !important;
  color: #bfdbfe !important;
}
.whatsapp-btn {
  border-radius: 16px !important;
}
#root > div > main > form button[type="submit"] {
  width: 100% !important;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg,#0b3d91,#1769e0) !important;
  border-radius: 17px !important;
  height: 56px !important;
  box-shadow: 0 10px 20px rgba(23,105,224,.25) !important;
}

#root > div > main > div {
  display: grid !important;
  gap: 12px !important;
}
.payment-card, .trust-card, .complaint-box {
  border: 0 !important;
  border-radius: 22px !important;
  box-shadow: 0 10px 25px rgba(25,52,90,.10) !important;
}
.payment-card {
  background: #fff !important;
  padding: 18px !important;
}
.payment-card h3 {
  color: #10213c !important;
}
.mpesa-box {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg,#075b35,#0b7a47) !important;
  border: 0 !important;
  border-radius: 16px !important;
}
.airtel-box {
  border: 0 !important;
  border-radius: 16px !important;
}
.trust-card {
  background: #fff !important;
  color: #53627a !important;
  padding: 20px !important;
}
.trust-card h3, .trust-card h4 {
  color: #0b3d91 !important;
}
.complaint-box {
  background: #fff !important;
  color: #53627a !important;
}

@media (min-width: 760px) {
  #root > div > main {
    max-width: 560px !important;
  }
}
@media (max-width: 480px) {
  #root > div > main > form {
    border-radius: 22px !important;
    padding: 18px 14px !important;
  }
}
</style>

</head>
<body>
  <div id="root"></div>
  <img src="data:image/png;base64,
